subject: Computer Networking
title: ICMP: Ping and Diagnostics
description: Learn ICMP: Ping and Diagnostics in one minute.

hook.text: You type 'ping google.com' and get a reply time. The protocol making that possible is ICMP.

buildup.text: ICMP carries error messages and operational info. It doesn't transport user data — it reports problems.

discovery.text: Ping sends an ICMP echo request. If the host is alive, it sends an echo reply. Simple and effective.

twist.text: Traceroute also uses ICMP. It maps every router hop between you and a destination by timing responses.

climax.text: Many firewalls block ICMP. That's why some hosts don't respond to ping even when they're online.

punchline.text: ICMP is the internet's error messenger.

quiz.question: What tool uses ICMP echo requests to test connectivity?

details.summary: ICMP carries error messages and diagnostic information between network devices. Ping uses ICMP echo requests and replies to test reachability and measure round-trip time. Traceroute uses ICMP to map the path packets take through the network, identifying each router along the way.
details.whyItMatters: ICMP is the primary tool for network troubleshooting. Ping and traceroute are the first commands every network engineer runs when diagnosing connectivity problems.
takeaways: Ping uses ICMP echo to test if a host is reachable
Traceroute maps each hop between source and destination
ICMP error messages report unreachable hosts and network problems

faq.question: How does traceroute work?
faq.answer: Traceroute sends packets with incrementing TTL values starting at 1. Each router decrements the TTL and discards packets when it reaches zero, sending back an ICMP time-exceeded message. This reveals each hop's IP address and round-trip time, mapping the entire path to the destination.

faq.question: Why do some hosts not respond to ping?
faq.answer: Many firewalls and servers block ICMP echo requests for security reasons. Cloud providers often disable ping by default. A host that does not respond to ping may still be fully operational and reachable on other ports. Use TCP-based checks when ICMP is blocked.
